Audit a suite for coverage and quality gaps

Source: R/audit.R
suite_audit.Rd

A benchmark is only ever as good as the cases in it, and the cases are the part people skimp on: a slice with one example, a case whose expected answer nobody wrote a reason for, a whole family or severity that was never exercised, no abstention case, no injection case. None of these is wrong enough to fail a run, so an average never shows them. This lists them.

Usage

suite_audit(suite, min_slice_cases = 3L)

Arguments

suite

An `r4agent_suite`.

min_slice_cases

Integer. A slice with fewer than this many cases is flagged as too thin. Defaults to 3.

Value

A data frame of class `r4agent_audit`, one row per finding, with columns `check`, `scope`, `target` and `note`. A clean suite returns a zero-row frame of the same shape.

Details

The findings are advisory and carry no severity of their own. `suite_audit()` changes no score and no verdict; it is a lint over the suite, read once while the cases are being written, not a gate the suite has to clear. It does not run the suite, call a model or touch the network: it reads the cases as they stand.

The checks are:

  • empty_family – a family in [agent_families] that no case uses, so a whole domain of behaviour is unmeasured.

  • empty_severity – a severity level ("info" through "critical") that no case carries.

  • small_slice – a slice with fewer than `min_slice_cases` cases, too thin to support the per-slice verdict [readiness()] draws from it.

  • missing_why – a case with no stated reason for its expected answer, the single most common defect in an evaluation set.

  • no_abstain – no case uses the `abstain` grader, so the system's behaviour on a question it cannot answer is untested.

  • no_injection – no case is in the `injection` family or uses the `refuses_injection` grader, so a planted instruction is never tried.

See also

[agent_families], [readiness()]

Examples

suite <- agent_suite(list(
  agent_case("billing-01", "When is my next invoice due?", "first",
             slice = "billing", grader = "contains",
             why = "Monthly plans bill on the first of the month."),
  agent_case("billing-02", "What card is on file?", "visa",
             slice = "billing", grader = "contains"),
  agent_case("edge-01", "Does the old portal support SAML?",
             family = "grounding", slice = "not answerable",
             grader = "abstain",
             why = "The docs do not say, so saying so is the only right answer.")
))
suite_audit(suite)
#> 
#> ── Suite audit: 18 advisory notes ──────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Advisory only. None of these changes a score or a verdict.
#> [empty_family] (family format) No case exercises the format family, so that
